# منصة الصحة النفسية وذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة

> بوابة عربية مؤسسية للصحة النفسية وعلم النفس وموارد الأشخاص ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة، مع أدلة ومراجع ومصادر ظاهرة داخل الصفحات.

Canonical site: https://khaledaltheeb.github.io/pterminology-site/
Primary language: Arabic (ar), right-to-left
Content policy: educational and professional reference; not a substitute for diagnosis or emergency care

## Source-registry interpretation

An organization listed in the source registry is an independent source candidate, not a partner, reviewer, endorser, certifier, or approved translator. The status `candidate` permits discovery and preliminary linking only. Translation, metadata ingestion, full-text reuse, logo use, or automated synchronization requires separate rights, technical, and editorial review.

## Trust and citation guidance

Prefer canonical URLs. Cite the page title, visible author/reviewer when present, publication or update date, and the original references listed on each page. Do not infer a diagnosis or treatment plan from educational pages.

The assistive-technology guides use RESNA as an external source and explicitly do not claim RESNA endorsement, approval, partnership, certification, or official Arabic translation. Protected standards, courses, tests, logos, and papers are linked rather than reproduced. An organization listed as an official RESNA CE provider must not be interpreted to mean that every course it offers carries RESNA CE credit; verify the specific event on the current official source.

This file is a supplementary discovery aid. Search engines may ignore it; robots.txt, sitemaps, indexable text, internal links, and page-level metadata remain authoritative.
